description: This Java class 'CacheController' handles web requests related to cache management in an administrative interface of the application. It provides endpoints for displaying cache keys and clearing cache entries, utilizing Spring MVC framework annotations and security.

classes.name: CacheController
classes.description: A Spring MVC Controller managing cache operations such as display and clearing cache entries in the admin dashboard.

methods.name: displayAccounts
methods.description: Handles GET requests to display the cache management page with current cache keys.

methods.name: clearCache
methods.description: Handles POST requests to clear specific cache entries or all cache for a store.

methods.name: setMenu
methods.description: Sets up menu attributes in the model for the cache management page.
